relevance.rationale: Identity confirmed from the document's own cover (arXiv:1701.06567v2 [hep-th], BPS spectra and 3-manifold invariants, four authors) and matches the seeded key. One citation site and it is load-bearing and VERIFIED: QOU/QBeta/StokesDTBPSBridge.lean:55 glosses it as 'GPPV 1701.06567 (BPS Hilbert space of T[M_3] categorifying the index)'. The document says exactly that — the categorifying object 'can be understood as the BPS Hilbert space of the effective 3d N = 2 theory T[M_3] on D^2 x R', obtained by reducing the 6d (2,0) theory on M_3, and the abstract states that the D^2 x S^1 half-index refines the Chern-Simons (WRT) invariant with an unrefined linear combination recovering the analytically continued WRT invariant. The citing file is also correctly scoped: its docstring states that it carries the two identifications (stokes = dt from the peacock conjecture, dt = bps from this source) as class FIELDS and does not carry the conclusion A_omega = 3 as a field, deriving that instead by composing them with a separately certified Stokes datum. That is the §3b-cond pattern applied honestly — the source is cited as a conjectural INPUT, not as established.

keyResults.locator: abstract + §1 (6d (2,0) on M_3 x D^2 x R)
keyResults.statement: Homological invariants H_a(M_3) labelled by abelian flat connections, physically defined as the BPS sector of the 6d (2,0) theory on M_3 x D^2 x R, equivalently the BPS Hilbert space of T[M_3] on D^2 x R; its D^2 x S^1 half-index refines the WRT invariant and an unrefined linear combination gives the analytically continued WRT invariant.
keyResults.useForFolio: It is the 'dt = bps' leg of the StokesDTBPSBridge conditional class, i.e. one of the two named conjectural inputs from which the 4_1 BPS count is derived rather than assumed.

proposedActions.rationale: Gloss verified against the source; the citing file treats it as a conjectural class field, which is the correct epistemic scoping. Nothing to change.
